model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна, показваща сравнение на точността (%) между пет различни модели – DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, SRPO и PPO+Self-reflection – във връзка с три различни задачи: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос представя трите категории на задачите, а вертикалната ос показва точността в проценти, с диапазон от 50 до 62 с интервали от 2%. Всеки комплект от стълбове, разположен под всяка категория по хоризонталната ос, съответства на един от петте модели, като различните модели са различени чрез уникални шаблони и цветове, които са посочени в легендата в горния десен ъгъл. Стълбовете във всяка група са подредени във визуално последователно изображение, като всеки стълб показва конкретна стойност на точност за съответния модел и задача. Всички стойности са измерени в проценти, а скалата по вертикалната ос е линейна.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of four different methods—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the three domains, while the vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with a scale increment of 1%. Each domain features a group of five bars, with each bar representing one method, as indicated by the legend. The bars are color-coded and patterned: DAPO+Self-reflection is light blue with a solid fill, GRPO is light orange with a diagonal hatched pattern, DAPO is light gray with a diagonal hatched pattern, PPO+Self-reflection is green with a solid fill, and SRPO is light green with a cross-hatched pattern. In the Mathverse domain, the accuracy values are approximately 53.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 54.1% for GRPO, 53.5% for DAPO, 54.7% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 53.7% for SRPO. In the MMLU domain, the values are approximately 57.1% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 55.9% for GRPO, 56.2% for DAPO, 56.4% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 54.8% for SRPO. In the Physics domain, the values are approximately 61.8% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58.3% for GRPO, 57.7% for DAPO, 59.5% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 60.6% for SRPO. The bars within each group are arranged side-by-side, and the chart does not appear to be sorted by any specific order, nor are any bars visually emphasized.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of five different models—DAPO+Self-reflection, GRPO, DAPO, SRPO, and PPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with gridlines at 1% intervals. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, five bars are grouped together, each representing one model and distinguished by a unique color and pattern, as indicated in the legend. In the Mathverse domain, the DAPO+Self-reflection model achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56.2%, followed by SRPO at 55.8%, GRPO at 53.5%, DAPO at 53.2%, and PPO at 53.3%. In the MMLU domain, DAPO+Self-reflection again shows the highest accuracy at about 57.0%, followed by SRPO at 57.1%, GRPO at 55.7%, DAPO at 55.9%, and PPO at 54.6%. In the Physics domain, DAPO+Self-reflection has the highest accuracy at approximately 60.8%, followed by SRPO at 60.6%, GRPO at 58.2%, DAPO at 57.5%, and PPO at 57.0%. Overall, DAPO+Self-reflection consistently achieves the highest accuracy across all three domains.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit in Prozent für verschiedene Modelle, die auf drei verschiedenen Datensätzen – Mathverse, MMLU und Physics – getestet wurden. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die drei Datensätze, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent von 50 bis 62 anzeigt, mit einem Intervall von 1. Für jeden Datensatz sind fünf gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die jeweils einem Modell entsprechen: DAPO+Self-reflection (blau), GRPO (orange mit diagonalen Strichen), DAPO (hellblau mit diagonalen Strichen), PPO+Self-reflection (grün) und SRPO (orange). Die Balken sind in einer Gruppe pro Datensatz angeordnet, wobei die Modelle in der Reihenfolge ihrer Beschriftung in der Legende dargestellt sind. Die Genauigkeitswerte variieren je nach Modell und Datensatz; beispielsweise liegt der höchste Wert bei DAPO+Self-reflection auf dem Physics-Datensatz bei etwa 61 %, während der niedrigste Wert bei DAPO auf dem Mathverse-Datensatz bei etwa 53 % liegt. Die Balken sind nicht nach ihrer Höhe sortiert, sondern gruppiert nach Datensätzen, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck.
